    Product Features

    • This square coffee table measures 70 x 70 x 36 cm and is equipped with Bluetooth APP connection in the middle to control and change the light. This unique design will add a futuristic flair to your space and create a cozy atmosphere.
    • Square design: The coffee table is square and measures 70x70x36 cm, which gives it a modern aesthetic.
    • LED lighting: The lighting system has been converted to LED lighting. It uses a Bluetooth connection with the mobile phone, the app controls and changes the lighting, offers different colors and dynamic modes, and is powered by the USB port. Note that there is no USB plug.
    • High-quality construction: The table is sturdy and can support up to 45 kg, giving it practical functionality.
    • Our modern white coffee table is perfect for modern living spaces. Its futuristic design and adjustable LED lighting add a high-tech atmosphere to your home.
    • White high-gloss coffee table with light strips for a futuristic look.
    • USB Powered -- Comes with a 5V 2A powered USB cable (USB plug not included) that can be plugged into your TV, computer and power bank, etc. Safe and easy to indoors use.
